intent: Issue 722: a refusal names the legal next verb; Errand raise needs --tried and refuses host-doable classes; --call on errand raise and issue ask; Decision refusals list the options; signal kind hint; limits in help; brief lists what a lead does itself on the mini.

findings.message: The required `tried` text is appended to the stored Errand detail, and `screenByRule` (via checkpoints-errands.ts:153) reads that stored detail, so what the lead ran first is now scanned as if it were the ask.
findings.failureScenario: Summary 'Rotate the OAuth consent in the Google console' (no hands word) with --tried '`gh api /repos/x` returned 403' -> the stored detail holds a backticked `gh` command, so the rule screen turns the Errand away as 'a command a token can run'. Re-raising with the same tried text is turned away again. Conversely, a tried text with a hands word ('opened the portal') switches the rule off for a real command Errand.
findings.fix: Store `tried` apart from `detail` (or run screenByRule and refuseHostClass only on summary and the lead's own detail), and add 'Tried first' only to what the owner reads.

findings.message: waitHint reuses the refused verb as the verb to take later, so some refusals name a verb that is not the legal next one.
findings.failureScenario: A lead that runs `artifact submit` during a review wait is told 'the verdict comes back as a note, then `artifact submit`' (the next verb after a verdict of changes is `artifact revise`). A lead that runs `issue ask` during a Decision wait is told 'then `issue ask`'.
findings.fix: Map the refused verb to its follow-up (submit to revise, ask to ship or the work it wanted) or word the hint without repeating the verb for submit and ask.

checked: call on ask and errand: written by the CLI flag (apps/cli/src/generated/operations.ts), passed on at apps/server/src/api/checkpoints.ts:194 and :538, and read at apps/server/src/app/checkpoints.ts:157 and :815
tried: required only in readErrand; all in-repo writers (e2e seed, scenarios, CLI tests) now send it; the console only reads errands
stored errand detail: written at apps/server/src/app/checkpoints.ts:809, read by screenByRule at apps/server/src/app/checkpoints-errands.ts:153 (finding)
refuseHostClass: runs before the replay lookup and the transaction, returns kind 'invalid', which api/checkpoints.ts:150 maps to a failure

waitHint: wait reasons match the WaitSpec union in domains/work/issue.ts; callers are fromTimer at table.ts:412-425; no other code matches the old refusal text except docs/rewrite/reports/8-api-parity.md (historical report)
Decision fields/detail: `fields` is passed through api/checkpoints.ts:149; no other code matches on the old strings

fieldHints in body-schema.ts: filing.ts imports only types from operation.ts, so no import cycle; operationIds signal.file, issue.ask, errand.raise and artifact.submit exist in the generated operations
brief commands: `door token new` exists in apps/cli/src/door.ts; `secrets-run read` and `secrets-run run` match apps/cli/src/credentials.ts
submit help: MAX_TITLE 200 and MAX_CONTENT 1000000 at domains/checkpoints/artifact.ts:25; the hardcoded copy in the CLI help is guarded by the new test

criteria.item: State machine refusal text per wait reason (errand, decision, review, dependency, stall) names how the wait ends and the verb to use
--call on errand raise and issue ask
Signal kind hint says where bug and feature belong
Limits of submit (and ship) in help
Errand refuses door token or route, install, sudo with no no-sudo attempt, and a Report missing from Needs you, with the route
Brief lists what a lead does itself on the mini
